title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Sports analyst Rob Parker doubts Boston Red Sox will maintain their form and make the 2026 playoffs.
The Red Sox stand firm in the second A.L. wild-card spot, with a record of 64-52 and 96% playoff chances.
FanGraphs reports 83.4% odds for Boston clinching a wild-card spot, following a strong mid-season performance.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was scratched from Saturday's Red Sox lineup due to leg swelling from a previous game injury.
Manager Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return for Sunday's game against the Athletics after receiving treatment.
Abreu holds the second-most home runs and RBIs on the team, with a .256 average and a .793 OPS in 2026.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Oakland Athletics.
Starting pitcher Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs over 5.1 innings, contributing to the defeat.
The Red Sox hold the American League's second wild-card spot, 1.5 games behind the Yankees.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf again due to an NFL policy requiring new testing for non-'E-layer' fields.
The current surface was installed after the World Cup but lacks NFL lab testing approval due to a missed procedural window.
Stadium officials chose not to use an 'E-layer' sub-base to avoid affecting ball bounce integrity, per team sources.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium, debuting player Jack Harrison.
Houston's Guilherme and Agustin Resch scored, exploiting New England's defensive weaknesses.
Revolution struggled offensively despite personnel changes, failing to capitalize on wide space plays.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony, out since May with a wrist injury, is practicing with a pitching machine for a potential late-season return.
Adley Rutschman, acquired by the Red Sox, made his first rehab appearance, signaling a closer return to active play.
Boston Red Sox maintain a nine-game winning streak, anticipating Anthony and Rutschman's return to strengthen the lineup.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: "Clueless" (1995) featuring Alicia Silverstone, now available on Netflix, explores relatable themes through a modern adaptation of Jane Austen's "Emma."
Bo Burnham's "Eighth Grade" (2018) provides an honest look at middle school anxiety, streaming on Netflix this August.
Season 4 of "Star Trek: Strange New Worlds" on Paramount+ features time travel and dinosaur adventures with younger versions of classic characters.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A Bigfoot sighting occurred on July 5 in Voluntown, Connecticut, as reported by witness Kevin Klimas.
The Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) verified the sighting in New London County, where there are multiple reported sightings.
Boston University professor Eva Garrett argues there is no scientific evidence supporting the existence of Bigfoot.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, passed away at 86; she was an advice columnist for Slate and The Boston Globe.
Margo emphasized moving past grief and encouraged finding new joy after loss, impacting the author's approach to advice.
Author Meredith Goldstein reflects on Howard's influence and shared memorable life lessons from their friendship.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox defeated the Oakland Athletics 13-1, extending their winning streak to nine games.
Payton Tolle struck out 14 batters in six innings, allowing 2 hits and no walks during the Red Sox's victory.
Red Sox hitters recorded 15 hits, including homers by Jarren Duran and RBIs by Wilyer Abreu and Jake Rogers.
